name: Tomas Tobé-Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Agreement between the European Union and the People’s Republic of Bangladesh on certain aspects of air services
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should formally conclude an air services agreement with Bangladesh. The deal removes legal uncertainty in existing bilateral air agreements between Bangladesh and eight EU countries. It lets any EU airline fly between Bangladesh and seven of those countries (Belgium, Denmark, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, France and Slovakia), where current bilateral deals do not already allow this. It also includes standard EU clauses on aviation safety, fuel taxation and competition rules.

- **What changes:** All EU airlines get fair access to routes between the EU and Bangladesh, subject to available traffic rights.
- **Who it affects:** Airlines and passengers in Belgium, Denmark, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, France and Slovakia, plus Bangladesh.
- **What happens next:** Parliament gives its consent; the agreement can then enter into force.
